profile_pipeline: profile a data pipeline by benchmarking each stage across different concurrency levels and measuring QPS
create_ProfileHook_subclass: create a custom ProfileHook subclass to execute code before and after each pipeline stage profiling
use_ProfileResult: use ProfileResult to inspect per-stage concurrency stats including QPS and queue occupancy rate
check_diagnostic_mode: check if SPDL pipeline diagnostic mode is enabled by reading the environment variable
set_default_profile_callback: set a default callback function that receives ProfileResult after each pipeline stage is profiled
